headline: Doctors Use Microwave Energy to Shrink Baby's Chest Tumour Before Birth
meta_description: Prenatal microwave treatment successfully shrank a potentially fatal tumour in a baby's chest within days, eliminating dangerous fluid buildup.
summary_short: Doctors used microwave energy to treat a life-threatening tumour in an unborn baby's chest. The tumour shrank significantly within three days.
body:
Doctors successfully used microwave energy to shrink a potentially fatal tumour in a baby's chest before birth. Within three days of treatment, the tumour had shrunk significantly and the dangerous fluid buildup that accompanied it had disappeared.

The case represents a rare application of microwave technology in prenatal medicine. Rather than waiting until after delivery to address the mass, the medical team intervened while the baby was still developing, preventing complications that could have threatened the infant's survival at birth.

This early intervention approach may offer new hope for expectant parents facing similar diagnoses. By treating the condition in the womb, doctors can reduce or eliminate health risks that would otherwise require emergency treatment immediately after delivery.
quick_facts: Microwave energy successfully shrunk a baby's chest tumour before birth
Tumour shrank significantly within three days of treatment
Dangerous fluid buildup disappeared after the procedure
